name: @funcd-dev/example-workflow
description: A five-step funcd Workflow example (ADR-0094): ingest → score → {hi | lo, exclusive via when} → report (join: any). Each step is an ordinary contract-bearing TypeScript function; the Workflow materializes them into owned Functions the engine drives. Authored against @funcd-dev/shim; vite build (@funcd-dev/vite-plugin) bundles each step to a self-contained <step>.mjs; each step's I/O contract lives in its <step>.funcdctl.yaml.
